title: Lottie
summary: Small accents in the modern style, generated from code in lottie/generate.mjs: heavy white strokes with butt ends and mitred corners, picture strips filled with the kit's studio-light tones, ghost-then-solid arrivals, expo-out landings with a small overshoot on the 0.2 s beat. Charcoal ground; no glow, no round caps.

items.name: Underline swipe
items.description: A heavy white bar swipes in from the left over a ghost bar, holds, then wipes out to the right.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: A heavy arrow: the shaft draws, the head snaps open from its point, and the arrow nudges forward on the beat.

items.name: Slash wipe
items.description: A heavy diagonal slash slams in, holds on the centre for a beat, and leaves right with a ghost slash trailing.

items.name: Ring draw
items.description: A thick white ring draws round with a hairline ghost ring inside; a square tick lands at twelve o'clock.

items.name: Plus
items.description: A heavy plus punches in with an overshoot and a ghost burst, then turns a quarter on the beat.

items.name: Check
items.description: A thin square box snaps in through a ghost, then a heavy check draws inside and punches.

items.name: Corner brackets
items.description: Four heavy corner brackets snap in from the centre to frame a subject, one after another, ghost then solid.

items.name: Dot grid
items.description: A 5x5 grid of square dots arriving in a scattered order, each ghost first then solid with a small punch.

items.name: Strip reveal
items.description: Three studio-light picture strips with staggered edges slide in from alternate ends, hold, and leave the same way.

items.name: Counter ticks
items.description: A ruler of ticks lighting from ghost to white one after another, long ticks every fifth, a marker riding the front.

items.name: Strip bars
items.description: Five picture-tone strips bouncing to the beat: each jumps on the grid, lands hard and eases down. Loops.

items.name: Beat square
items.description: A solid white square punching on every beat with a ghost outline expanding off it. Loops.
